repos_data.description: Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
Fast, private push-to-talk dictation for Apple Silicon Macs — local Parakeet TDT v3, no cloud or telemetry.
Scriptable local dictation that uses the text on your screen to fix names, and your rules to format numbers, dates, and links.
MIT-licensed voice dictation for macOS and Windows with local Whisper, Parakeet and Canary models, plus optional cloud transcription | Rust + Tauri

Free, open-source Mac app for local transcription and dictation. Transcribe audio, video, YouTube and meetings with Whisper or Parakeet, fully offline. A MacWhisper and Wispr Flow alternative for Apple Silicon.

Free, open-source macOS menu bar dictation that never leaves your Mac. Fast on-device speech-to-text (voice typing) for German & English. 100% offline & private alternative to Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and MacWhisper.
